blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Four big-ticket projects in the Philippine Economic Zone Authority’s (Peza) pipeline could propel the agency to an all-time high in investment approvals this year, potentially surpassing its P311-billion record by about P200 billion. Peza Director General Tereso Panga said the agency, which had already approved P297.14 billion worth of projects as of September, […]...
